title: Balanced Binary Tree
prompt: Given a binary tree, determine if it is height-balanced. A height-balanced binary tree is defined as: a binary tree in which the left and right subtrees of every node differ in height by no more than 1.
hints: For each node, check if |leftHeight - rightHeight| <= 1 and both subtrees are balanced.
Use a helper that returns height. Return -1 or special value to indicate unbalanced (to avoid redundant checks).
If any subtree returns -1 (unbalanced), propagate -1. Otherwise return 1 + max(left, right).
O(n) time - each node visited once.
